Value of assets transferred in each merger

Source: R/cases.R
transfer_value.Rd

Sums the fair market value of the asset lines the donor reported for its recipient, by asset class. With core, it also compares the total to the donor's beginning-of-year assets (COVERAGE) and flags implausible values.

Usage

transfer_value(cases, tx, core = NULL, max_coverage = 2)

Arguments

cases

Output of build_merger_cases().

tx

Output of sn_transactions().

core

Optional organization-year table from org_years().

max_coverage

Flag transfers above this multiple of the donor's beginning-of-year assets.

Value

A data.table, one row per MERGER_ID, with:

  • FMV_<class> columns (see asset_class());

  • FMV_TOTAL (all lines as reported) and FMV_ASSETS (excluding liabilities assumed, which filers usually enter as positive amounts);

  • N_LINES, N_FMV_MISSING, and ANY_NEGATIVE;

  • with core: DONOR_ASSETS_BOY, COVERAGE (FMV_ASSETS divided by the donor's beginning-of-year assets), and FLAG_OUTLIER (coverage above max_coverage, or negative FMV_ASSETS).
